title: Five in a row
tagline: Five stones in a line. Simple to learn, deep to master.
teaser: Take turns placing stones on a wide grid. Line up five before the computer does, and watch for its traps.

manPage.synopsis: gomoku — place stones; get five in a row first.
manPage.description: Ralph Campbell’s gomoku, whose board display was based on Peter Langston’s goref program.

howToPlay: Take turns placing a stone on the grid.
Get five of yours in a row: across, down or diagonal.
Block the computer before it lines up five.
